spans.s: शोष m. 1. Drying up, dryness, शफरीं ह्रदशोषित्विक्लवाम् K.S.iv.39; 2. emaciation, withering, किं शोषमायासि मृणालहार Rat.iii.; 3. pulmonary consumption.
शोष-संभव n. the root of long pepper.
शोषण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Drying up; 2. causing to wither.
शोषण (II) m. One of the arrows of the god of love.
शोषण (III) n. 1. Drying up; 2. absorption, suction; 3. exhaustion; 4. dry ginger.
शोषण (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Drying up; 2. causing to wither.
शोषित a. (f. ता) 1. Dried up; 2. exhausted.
शोषित a. (f. ता) 1. Dried up; 2. exhausted.
